Local browser library; no runtime CDN requests or package installation.

- [DOMPurify 3.4.16](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/releases/tag/3.4.16): `purify.min.js`, license in `DOMPurify-LICENSE`.

Task Markdown is rendered on demand by the vendored Python Mistune library. The page receives HTML and sanitizes it before insertion. Raw Markdown is not returned by the task API.
